room_envelope.derivation: Representative right-wall plane plus 2 cm, observed window structural depth 95th percentile, and ceiling plane plus 4 cm; rounded outward to centimeters
limitations: Axis-aligned envelope approximates recovered wall slopes/recesses.
Window/left-wall individual plane inlier fractions are below 50%; this is an observed extent bound, not a surveyed rectangular room.
All dimensions inherit the assumed table-height scale.

uncertainty.mass_and_friction: assumed from object class; not inferred from RGB
